newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Colonial Downs shares flat.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Colonial Downs shares flat.

text.p: Shares of Colonial Downs Holdings Inc were flat at their initial public offering price of $9.50 in early afternoon trading, down from their opening price of $10 a share.
The 4.25 million shares priced within the estimated range of $9 to $11 per share, revised earlier from a range $8 to $10 a share.
The Providence Forge, Va.- based company was formed to pursue the business of horse racing and "pari-mutuel" wagering in Virginia.

The company said in its filing the proceeds of the offering would be used towards completing the construction a race track, harnessing satellite wagering facilities, repaying financing acquired from certain shareholders, and for other corporate purposes.
Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co was lead underwriter on the deal.
